items.title: The slow reconciliation of Polish and Ukrainian memories over World War II mass graves
items.description: In the former villages of Wola Ostrowiecka and Ostrowki in western Ukraine, archaeologists and historians have been exhuming the bodies of Polish civilians massacred by Ukrainian nationalists in 1943. More than 80 years later, this painful past still weighs on diplomatic relations between Kyiv and Warsaw.

items.title: Rescue Operations Under Way After Russian Deadly Strike On Ukrainian Shopping Mall
items.description: Search-and-rescue operations continue at the site of a devastating Russian drone attack on a shopping mall in the Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih, as Russia continues to strike across Ukraine.

items.title: 'Masha and the Bear': Ukraine sanctions Russian cartoon
items.description: Ukraine has imposed sanctions on the hit Russian children's cartoon "Masha and the Bear," a step towards banning it. The culture minister called the show propaganda. Russia said the move showed Kyiv's "ugly nature."

items.title: Russian missiles kill 17 more in Ukraine as Guterres calls for ceasefire
items.description: Russian ballistic missile strikes killed 17 people and injured more than 40 in and around the Ukrainian capital Kyiv on Thursday, local authorities reported.
